allow: PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/stats" -UseBasicParsing | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Content | ConvertFrom-Json | Select-Object -ExpandProperty data | Select-Object totalDonors, totalDonations, pendingRequests, totalUnits)

PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/stats" -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($r\) { $r.Content.Substring\(0,300\) } else { "Server not responding on 3000" })

PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/donors?active=1" -UseBasicParsing; $data = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; "Donors: $\($data.data.Count\)"; $r2 = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/inventory" -UseBasicParsing; $d2 = $r2.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; "Inventory: $\($d2.data.Count\)"; $r3 = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/requests" -UseBasicParsing; $d3 = $r3.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; "Requests: $\($d3.data.Count\)")
